metadata.clan_summary:
[bold]RESEARCH PROMPT:[/bold] I would
like to add a link that targrets the audio file generated by the audio agent in the
`#research_swarm` xprompt swarm to the final report that is created by the linker agent
in this swarm (which should always run when the audio agent runs).

- The idea is to allow the user to quickly play the narrated audio summary of the
  research file while reading the research file.
- Ideally, this will be something that works well with the `bob highlights create`
  command, which we have configured as a file hook. Keep in mind that you are free to
  improve the `bob highlights create` command in order to support this feature better if
  you think that's necessary.
- I want you to lead the design on this one. Make sure you design this feature so it is intuitive, reliable, and (last but not least) beautiful!

Can you do some research with the goal of helping me decide the best way to implement
this? Also, critique this plan in general. Is this a good idea? Would you take a
different approach? Make any adjustments to the requirements that you think are
justified but clearly call these out. End your analysis with a recommended solution.
